channel.title: Antiraedus Blog
channel.description: Blog posts from Antiraedus — thoughts on engineering, projects, and more.

item.title: Inside SoulSync — Architecture & the Free CI Release Pipeline
item.description: SoulSync is now fully open source. A quick tour of how a privacy-first, 100%-on-device mood tracker is built — and the free GitHub Actions pipeline that signs and ships every release.

item.title: Anti's Incomprehensive Notes and Thoughts On Socialisation
item.description: A guide on how to socialise with people, with rough data and thoughts. Let's build a model of socialisation!

item.title: Cycles - My current progression system, and fixing habits
item.description: My current mental model on achieving progress over time that's been working for me over the past 2 months.

item.title: The Woes of Writing Posts
item.description: A small insight on how I sometimes write posts... It's not very chronological!!

item.title: Reflecting Rays, Circular Mirrors and Points
item.description: A problem about how light would reflect in a perfectly circular mirror (and some interesting questions extending into 3D). Took disproportionately long to make this post relative to how long it takes to solve it. Learnt Mathjax here.

item.title: Flask Weather Data Exchange
item.description: Flask website with encrypted login system, displaying data from BOM API. Made as my last school assignment.

item.title: The Demon in the Machine | Book Review
item.description: A quick review on The Demon in the Machine, with small tangents on information and competing theories. Fun!

item.title: Exploring the realm of crushes
item.description: An exploration of crushes - a domain I'm not well versed in, which is why this article was made. On the importance of attractions/relationships and the lack of verbal knowledge about this. Survey n=~30 data gathered about crushes so you can create (more) data-based opinion on related topics!

item.title: Dungeons and Data Structures Hackathon Reflection
item.description: A little analysis on my first ever hackathon. Hosted by Coder One as their AI Sports Challenge 2021, it seemed like a fun starting point and I learnt a lot in this (especially around workflows and realistic team-based projects).

item.title: Basic Flask website
item.description: A simple flask website made in python that lets the user read/write to a database. Made for a school assignment.

item.title: Short Story: Shadow of Oneself
item.description: This was a little short story I made for my Year 11 'short story' (more flash fiction) exam. I hated that test - How is a short story only 800-1000 words?? YOU CAN'T DO ANYTHING WITH THAT. I also had to extract this idea from a stimulus about some normal family at a dinner table. Safe to say I er... Exercised my creative ability on it :)

item.title: Frame of War
item.description: First game I've made, using gamemaker (lol). It's pretty hard. You should try it ;)
